description: Live cost of one USDT (TRC-20) transfer on TRON: TRX burned when the sender has no energy (to an address that already holds USDT and to a new one), what it costs with enough staked or rented energy, the current energy and bandwidth prices, address activation cost and how much TRX must be staked to cover one transfer a day. Includes why the fee changes between days and wallets. Use it for "how much does it cost to send USDT" questions on TRON; for the fee to one specific recipient use check_address, and for other networks use compare_usdt_networks. Returns USD and TRX amounts plus a source page. Energy price refreshes every few minutes; results are cached for about a minute.
name: get_usdt_fee
title: USDT TRC-20 transfer fee
